about.title: About utils
about.p1: utils is a collection of self-hosted web utilities built and maintained by <owner>Zihao Liu</owner>. It exists for three reasons: everyday tools for personal use, simple apps for family, and an open-source starting point for anyone who wants to self-host their own toolbox.
about.p2: The next big milestone is the agent chat: a browser UI for talking to AI coding agents (like Claude Code) running on our own server, inside Docker — your conversations never depend on a third-party hosted frontend.

chat.title: Ask the book
chat.passcodePrompt: Enter the family passcode to use the AI assistant
chat.greeting: Ask anything about the book — it looks up the relevant entries first and cites the section and item.
chat.placeholder: e.g. Should I co-sign a loan for a friend?
chat.busy: The assistant is answering someone else — try again in a moment.
chat.rateLimited: The model is currently rate-limited. Try again later; a recovery time was not reported.
chat.timeout: The answer took too long — try again, or pick a faster model.
chat.error: The assistant failed to answer. Please try again.
chat.disclaimer: Answers cite the book. Check the original entries when making decisions.
chat.emptyTitle: Read, ask, and return to the source
chat.exampleDecision: Compare two choices and their tradeoffs
chat.exampleEvidence: Find a few free, easy changes I can start today
chat.exampleExcerpt: Explain an entry — select a passage in the book first
chat.excerptQuestion: Explain this passage and its evidence and limitations.
chat.inputHint: Desktop: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Touch: Enter adds a line.
chat.disconnected: Connection lost. This answer is incomplete; you can retry.
chat.bookUnavailable: This book version is unavailable. Try refreshing the reader.
chat.historyFailed: Could not restore the conversation. Retry before sending a new question.
chat.sessionExpired: Your login expired. Log in again to continue.
chat.versionChanged: This conversation uses an older book version. Start a new chat to ask about the current version.
chat.citationMissing: Section {section}, item {item} — unavailable in this version
chat.tokenScope: Reported usage for this turn's main conversation, including context and book results. Total includes reported cache tokens. Unreported calls are excluded; this is not a bill.
chat.timingNote: Local elapsed time is approximate after Stop or disconnection. Reload to retrieve final server timing when available.
chat.titleLength: Enter a title between 1 and 100 characters.
chat.historyBusy: This conversation is still running. Open it and confirm Stop first.
chat.quotaScope: Requests that reach the AI service count, including failed or stopped requests. Failures before an upstream attempt are released. This is a request limit, not a token or billing limit.
chat.confirming: Checking the server result. No new AI request is being sent.
chat.stop_unconfirmed: The final server state is not yet confirmed. Check again before switching conversations.
chat.logout_failed: Could not log out. Try again.
chat.interrupted: This request was interrupted. Its saved response is incomplete.
chat.archivedNotice: This conversation is archived. Restore it from History to continue.
chat.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please select and copy the text manually.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: An unexpected error occurred. Try again — if it keeps happening, please open an issue on GitHub.
